Common.name: A Feather of the Phoenix
Common.desc: Discard 1 card, then target 1 card in your GY; return that target to the top of your Deck.

Common.name: B.E.S. Crystal Core
Common.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can change 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls to face-up Defense Position.

Common.name: Chiron the Mage
Common.desc: Once per turn: You can discard 1 Spell Card, then target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

Common.name: Contract with the Abyss
Common.desc: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any DARK Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels exactly equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon.

Common.name: Fairy Dragon
Common.desc: This beautiful Dragon spirit harbors hidden strength.

Common.name: Gravekeeper's Chief
Common.desc: You can only control 1 face-up "Gravekeeper's Chief". Your GY is unaffected by "Necrovalley". When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster in your GY; Special Summon that target.

Common.name: Kaibaman
Common.desc: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your hand.

Common.name: Necrovalley
Common.desc: All "Gravekeeper's" monsters gain 500 ATK and DEF. Cards in the Graveyard cannot be banished. Negate any card effect that would move a card in the Graveyard to a different place. Negate any card effect that changes Types or Attributes in the Graveyard.

Common.name: Wild Nature's Release
Common.desc: Target 1 Beast or Beast-Warrior-Type monster; it gains ATK equal to its current DEF until the End Phase. During the End Phase, destroy it.

Rare.name: D.D. Assailant
Rare.desc: After damage calculation, when this card is destroyed by battle with an opponent's monster: Banish that monster, also banish this card.

Rare.name: Goldd, Wu-Lord of Dark World
Rare.desc: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: If it was discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect, you can target up to 2 cards your opponent controls; Special Summon this card from the Graveyard, then destroy those targets (if any).

Rare.name: Manticore of Darkness
Rare.desc: During the End Phase of the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard: You can send to the Graveyard 1 Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast-Type monster from your hand or your side of the field; Special Summon this card from your Graveyard.

Rare.name: Pikeru's Circle of Enchantment
Rare.desc: Damage to you from card effects becomes 0 until the end of this turn.

Rare.name: The Agent of Judgment - Saturn
Rare.desc: While your Life Points are higher than your opponent's, you can Tribute this card to inflict damage to your opponent equal to the difference. If you do not control a face-up "The Sanctuary in the Sky", this effect is not applied. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this effect.

Rare.name: Widespread Ruin
Rare.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy the Attack Position monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied).

Super Rare.name: Dark World Lightning
Super Rare.desc: Target 1 Set card on the field; destroy that target, then discard 1 card.

Super Rare.name: Gravekeeper's Spy
Super Rare.desc: FLIP: Special Summon 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck.

Super Rare.name: Snipe Hunter
Super Rare.desc: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 card on the field; roll a six-sided die, and destroy that target unless you roll a 1 or 6.

Super Rare.name: Spirit Reaper
Super Rare.desc: Cannot be destroyed by battle. After resolving a card effect that targets this face-up card, destroy this card. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Discard 1 random card from their hand.

Ultra Rare.name: Magicians Unite
Ultra Rare.desc: If you control 2 or more Attack Position Spellcaster monsters: Target 1 of them; its ATK becomes 3000 until the end of this turn, also for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, other Spellcaster monsters you control cannot attack.
